sources.snippet: Pyramis-L3D is a hierarchical sparse attention language model research prototype. It models attention as a three-tier pyramidal memory hierarchy, inspired by CPU multi-level caches (L1/L2/L3) and the TLB (translation lookaside buffer).

sources.snippet: Pyramis-L3D is a hierarchical / sparse attention research prototype. Inspired by CPU multi-level caches (L1/L2/L3) and the TLB (translation lookaside buffer), it models attention as a three-tier pyramidal storage system — targeting sub-linear KV-cache storage and O (k) query-time sparse routing.
